title: Redis
description: Memory, clients, commands, hit rate, evictions and replication from INFO of Redis or Valkey, inside module_targets, module_hosts and module_ports (by default loopback, localhost, 6379 among others) or over a socket below module_sockets.

socket.title: Unix socket
socket.description: Path of Redis' unixsocket instead of the address, e.g. /run/redis/redis-server.sock.

username.title: User
username.description: ACL user (Redis 6 and later); empty: the default user.

auth.title: Password
auth.description: requirepass or the ACL user's password; a user with +info only is enough.

tls.title: TLS
tls.description: off, verify (the certificate against the system's CAs or ca_file), no_verify (any certificate: encrypted, but to whoever answers). Empty: off on loopback and the socket, verify for any other address. For the tls-port of Redis 6 and later.

ca_file.title: CA file
ca_file.description: PEM file below module_file_prefixes to verify the certificate of Redis with instead of the system's CAs (tls verify).
